in_app_purchases.review_note: One-time unlock. Lifts the free limits: unlimited child profiles and tiles, up to 50 items per playlist, all six games. Reached from any limit (e.g. adding a second profile) or Parent area > Unlock Burrow. Parental gate: enter any adult birth year, e.g. 1990.

en-US: Unlimited profiles, tiles and every game
es-ES: Perfiles, mosaicos y juegos sin límite
fr-FR: Profils, tuiles et jeux sans limite
nl-NL: Onbeperkt profielen, tegels en alle spellen

in_app_purchases.review_note: Free time-based trial per guideline 3.1.1, named 'XX-day Trial'. Its purchase date starts 14 days of everything in Burrow Full; afterwards the free limits return with the parent's content intact. Parent area > Unlock Burrow > Try everything free for 14 days.

en-US: Everything in Burrow Full for 14 days
de-DE: Alles aus Burrow Full für 14 Tage
